notes:
Lead profile: mid-size clinical documentation platform serving ambulatory clinics and specialty groups. Primary problem: clinicians waste time finding contextual notes; need sub-1s search for top-K rerank and strict PHI controls. Team comment snippets and CRM-style bullets:
- 'We need strict access logging and per-token audit trails.' — VP Eng
- Data size: ~6-12M clinical notes (text bodies + structured metadata). Expect index ~8-12M vectors, 2TB raw text.
- Latency targets: p50 < 200ms for embedding lookup + rerank; p95 < 800ms. Prefer p50 <100ms for rerank if on dedicated hardware.
- Cost sensitivity: wants guidance to hit <$0.020/query for typical rerank (embedding + candidate retrieval + cross-encoder rerank) at 5k QPS burst.
- Model preferences: open/embed models for vector generation; cross-encoder reranker preferred for top-10 quality. Open to quantized LLM reranker on dedicated GPUs.
- Security: HIPAA required, SOC2 nice-to-have; mandatory SSO (SAML + SCIM), KMS for key separation, immutable audit logs, retention controls.
- Networking: must run in customer VPC or air-gapped appliance for some customers; VPN/VPC peering and strict egress rules required.
- POC ask: provide private deployment image for on-prem test with synthetic PHI, show audit log granularity, demonstrate prefix/KV cache benefit on real workload.
- Economics: ask for cost model template showing tokens per query, batching gains, and dedicated pool pricing.
- Quote: 'If we can keep clinician search fast and provably auditable we can reduce chart review time by 30%.' — Dir Product
- Internal stakeholders: CTO (security signoff), Dir Product (POC owner), Head of Clinical Ops (end-user champion).
